name: Vesselspecies Pattern
description: to provide a direct relation between aquatic species and vessels that are able to catch them, regardless of the fishing gear used.
scenarios: give me the species caught using 'gillneters'
competency_questions: what vessel types can catch what species? (provided that species are caught by geartypes are used by vessel types)
